recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man in a textured tan jacket looking downward, set against a dark, moody interior featuring a large ornate picture frame. The composition uses a warm, desaturated palette with a focus on tactile fabric textures and soft directional lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's downward gaze creates a diagonal line leading toward the negative space on the right.
The vertical lines of the architectural column and picture frame anchor the subject in the environment.
Contrast between the light tan jacket and the dark interior background creates depth.
Typography is placed in the dark void of the picture frame for maximum legibility.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a medium-close shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the bright tan jacket serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the gaze down to the jacket, then moves right to the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark interior of the picture frame on the right provides a clean area for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the background provide a somber foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tan and beige of the jacket provide the primary light source and contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold/yellow for the primary text and soft blue for the secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
Small x-height for a classic, literary feel

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the dark background of the frame
Placed over the dark background of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic serif family with color-based hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Ornate picture frame as a layout container

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the soft, rounded serif terminals and classic feel.
Provides the appropriate x-height and humanist proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a moody interior portrait of a man with dark wavy hair wearing a textured tan linen jacket over a black shirt. He is looking down pensively. To his right is a large, dark, ornate wooden picture frame. The lighting is soft and directional, creating a film-grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two levels of right-aligned serif text inside the dark area of the picture frame. The top line should be large, lowercase, and muted gold. The bottom two lines should be smaller, lowercase, widely tracked, and muted slate blue.

verificationChecks: Is the jacket texture visible and linen-like?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones and muted accents?
Is the subject looking down away from the camera?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the tan jacket
Tracking width of the subtitle text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the artist name and title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the dark frame background.
Verify the jacket color doesn't wash out the subject's face.
Check that the gaze direction leads the eye toward the text.
Confirm the serif font has a classic, non-modern appearance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject in textured light outerwear + dark architectural background + right-aligned lowercase serif typography in a frame.
